title: Pre-pass go/no-go review for a five-satellite LEO constellation
objective: Assign go, no_go or hold to five satellites from TLE freshness, downlink margin and IADC 25-year disposal compliance.

decision_questions.stale_tle_cleared: Does any satellite whose TLE epoch is older than 72 hours receive go?
decision_questions.sub_minimum_link_closes: Does the result describe a link with margin below 3.0 dB as closing?

traps.SAT-3: Best link margin (11.2 dB) and shortest disposal lifetime (4.1 years), but its TLE epoch is 96.5 hours old, so the TLE-freshness hook blocks orbit_propagate: hold, not go.
traps.SAT-2: Sits exactly on two boundaries: TLE age 72.0 h is not above the 72 h limit, and margin 3.0 dB satisfies margin >= 3.0, so link_closes is true. A careless run marks it hold or no_go.
traps.SAT-4: Margin 2.9 dB is 0.1 dB below the 3.0 dB minimum; rounding to 3 dB gives go, but link_budget_calc returns link_closes false.
traps.SAT-5: Everything else is clean, but the predicted post-mission lifetime of 25.4 years exceeds the IADC 25-year guideline, so the disposal plan is non-compliant.
